title: Unravelling microbiome changes in aerobic granular sludge saline wastewater treatment using a slow stepwise salt increase strategy
content:
Environ. Sci.: Adv., 2024, 3,1788-1801
DOI: 10.1039/D4VA00248B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Ana M. S. Paulo, Oihane Salazar, Joana Costa, Daniela P. Mesquita, Eugénio C. Ferreira, Paula M. L. Castro, Catarina L. Amorim
A gradual stepwise salt increase strategy applied to an AGS system proved vital for maintaining process stability and performance. This strategy promoted the persistence of key microbes, especially those crucial for nutrient removal.
